name: PyPI
label: PyPI Warehouse JSON API
description: PyPI Warehouse JSON / upload via OfficialApiNode. Docs: https://docs.pypi.org/api/. Operations: project_get, version_get, files_list, upload. search is removed: XML-RPC search is permanently disabled (https://warehouse.pypa.io/api-reference/xml-rpc/); use project_get or https://pypi.org/search in a browser. Auth secret token is instance config only (never on INPUT, never logged). listen/trigger are kind:ingress — use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. Failures are output.error. JDK HTTP, official API only.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Path params such as id match api_spec.json placeholders.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official API call to run. EXACT values: project_get | version_get | files_list | upload. search was removed (XML-RPC search retired). Prefer the instance config operation select. listen/trigger are ingress: they do not call HTTP — use a BPMN message event. Example: 'project_get'.

schema.label: content
schema.description: upload wheel/sdist file (Warehouse multipart part content). Required on upload. Example: a platform file block.

schema.label: filetype
schema.description: upload. EXACT: sdist | bdist_wheel. Example: bdist_wheel.

schema.label: pyversion
schema.description: upload Python tag, e.g. py3 or source. Example: py3.

schema.label: md5_digest
schema.description: upload hex MD5 of the file. Example: d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e.

schema.label: sha256_digest
schema.description: upload hex SHA-256 of the file (preferred).

schema.label: action
schema.description: upload form :action. Default file_upload. Example: file_upload.

schema.label: file
schema.description: Distribution content for PyPI upload (multipart). Example: platform file ref.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status:ok, http_status, data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or raw text.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official API operation. EXACT: project_get, version_get, files_list, upload. search was removed (XML-RPC search retired). listen is BPMN ingress, not a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Token
configurationParameters.description: PyPI API token for upload (__token__ as username). Public JSON GET does not need it.

configurationParameters.label: File
configurationParameters.description: Distribution content for PyPI upload (multipart). Example: platform file ref.

configurationParameters.label: PyPI Basic User
configurationParameters.description: Fixed Warehouse basic-auth username for API tokens. Always __token__. Not user-facing.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect + read timeout. Default 25. Keep at or below the daemon stateful budget (~300s).
